posts.text:
The real issue is whether AI markets are producing socially optimal innovation. @DAcemogluMIT argues there is too much labor-replacing AI and too little labor-augmenting AI. We need to reverse the capital bias to incentivize technologies that increase total factor productivity by making workers more valuable, rather than eliminating them.


Brian Albrecht (@BrianCAlbrecht)

A "compute tax" fails on basically all the basics of optimal taxation.
 
- Don't tax capital 
- Don't tax intermediate good
